You will be responsible for the design and implementation of FPGA code either with a focus on DSP algorithms to modulate and demodulate signals on board our software defined radio (SDR), or embedded systems interfacing with processors and peripherals. This individual will serve as a trusted advisor to the CEO, executive leadership team, and Board of Directors while leading the company's legal strategy in support of rapid growth, international expansion, government contracting, satellite licensing, spectrum management, and strategic commercial initiatives. The successful candidate will oversee both Legal and Regulatory Affairs teams and will help shape company strategy by proactively identifying legal and regulatory opportunities and risks.

jobs.title: IT Intern (January 2027) (4 months)
jobs.description_text: What We Offer: - Build and operate real satellites! - Get hands-on with cutting-edge space technology and real-world engineering challenges. - Dedicated mentorship to support your learning and growth. - Fun and collaborative work environment where you'll learn quickly and feel supported. - Team-building events and opportunities to connect across the company. - Fully stocked Toronto office kitchen with snacks, drinks, games, and top-notch kitchen appliances. - Frequent in-office and company-wide events to stay connected and engaged. - Make a direct impact on Kepler's growth and success. - We’re a certified Great Place to Work® seven years in a row. The IT team supports Kepler’s employees by providing reliable technology, systems, and technical assistance that enable teams to do their best work. As an IT Intern, you will gain hands-on experience in a supportive, learning-focused environment while contributing to day-to-day IT operations. This 4-month internship is designed for students early in their IT careers who are eager to learn, develop technical skills, and explore different areas of information technology. You will work closely with experienced IT team members and receive guidance, training, and mentorship throughout the internship. *Must be eligible to obtain and maintain Government of Canada Reliability Status*

jobs.title: Lead (Chief) Satellite Systems Engineer (Contingent)
jobs.description_text: Position Status: Contingent Upon Program Award As a Lead (Chief) Satellite Systems Engineer, you will serve as a primary technical authority for satellite and space-system development programs, ensuring the integrity of system design, integration, verification, and mission readiness from concept through delivery. You will translate program objectives into executable technical plans, aligning requirements, architecture, interfaces, trade studies, verification evidence, and risk decisions across a large cross-functional team. The ideal candidate has demonstrated experience delivering through at least one satellite-level program lifecycle. Experience with constellation-level architectures, multi-satellite delivery, or cross-program technical execution is a strong asset. This role requires strong systems engineering judgment, the ability to lead through ambiguity, and the communication discipline to align teams and stakeholders while balancing technical integrity with cost, schedule, risk, mission assurance, and customer expectations. This position is intended for a technical leader who can operate with credibility across engineering, program management, product assurance, suppliers, customers, and senior leadership. T1/T2 expectations emphasize ownership of technical outcomes, disciplined integration, requirements alignment, decision closure, readiness evidence, and system-wide integration readiness across multiple subsystems.

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Designer (6+ month Contract)
jobs.description_text: Please note: Kepler is managing recruitment for this contract position directly. We are not accepting agency submissions or unsolicited candidate profiles for this role. Any profiles submitted by an agency without a signed agreement and prior written authorization from Kepler’s Talent Acquisition team will not be eligible for a placement fee. We're on the hunt for a top-tier Senior Embedded Software Engineer for a 6+ month contract. Your focus will be on software development and maintenance required for both space and ground-based assets for a growing fleet of spacecraft. You'll be relied upon for input and decisions that will directly impact design and operation.

jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel – Technology & Trade Compliance
jobs.description_text: As Senior Legal Counsel – Technology & Trade Compliance, this isn’t your typical legal position. At Kepler, you’ll be embedded in a fast-moving team, helping to shape how we operate globally by balancing legal precision with bold innovation. You’ll provide hands-on legal expertise across a vast array of commercial agreements and government engagements, all while supporting cutting-edge space technology projects. As we push the boundaries of space-based connectivity, your work will ensure Kepler remains not only compliant but competitive in a highly regulated and technically complex landscape. Your decisions will directly influence how we launch, partner, build, and operate globally.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Marketing
jobs.description_text: Role Summary Lexeo’s Commercial team is building the strategy, insights, brand and infrastructure required to bring LX2006 to patients – marking Lexeo’s transition from a clinical-stage to a commercial company. We are seeking an Associate Director, Marketing to play a central role in preparing for the launch of LX2006, Lexeo’s first commercial product, anticipated in the US in 2028 and globally thereafter. Reporting to the Senior Director, Marketing, this individual will serve as the LX2006 brand lead, owning critical launch workstreams end to end – from customer insights and competitive intelligence to market development, campaigns, customer targeting and launch readiness – and working closely with cross-functional partners in Market Access/HEOR, Medical Affairs, Patient Affairs, Clinical Development, Regulatory, Legal, CMC, and Business Development (ad hoc) as part of Lexeo’s Launch Readiness Team. The role will also support early commercial planning for LX2020, Lexeo’s gene therapy candidate for PKP2-associated arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy. This is a highly visible, hands-on opportunity to build a launch from the ground up and help shape the commercial foundation of a growing clinical stage company. We welcome applications from candidates located across the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic.

jobs.title: Scientist I/II, In Vivo Pharmacology
jobs.description_text: Role Summary Lexeo is seeking a hands-on in vivo pharmacologist to build rodent models of cardiac disease and use them to de-risk targets, screen therapeutic candidates and advance our discovery pipeline. The scientist will design, perform or manage rodent studies from target validation through hit identification, working cross-functionally with In Vitro Pharmacology, Modality Engineering, and Translational Sciences to select-advance molecules. Reporting to the Head of Cardiac Research, this role joins cardiac, neuroscience, and non-clinical scientists developing therapies for genetic heart disease and offers broad experience in multidisciplinary biopharma research.

jobs.title: Scientist I/II, Modality Engineering
jobs.description_text: Role Summary Lexeo is hiring a hands-on Modality Engineering Scientist to design, synthesize, and characterize oligonucleotides, bioconjugates, and AAV therapeutics for our discovery pipeline. The scientist will advance molecules from design through analytical characterization and handoff to in vitro and in vivo teams, working across chemistry, molecular biology, and pharmacology. Reporting to the Head of Cardiac Research, this role joins cardiac, neuroscience, and non-clinical scientists developing therapies for genetic heart disease and offers broad experience in multidisciplinary biopharma research.

jobs.title: Scientist II, Cellular Neuroscience and Translational Pharmacology
jobs.description_text: Role Summary We are seeking a highly collaborative, hands-on Scientist II to help establish a preclinical neuroscience laboratory supporting small-molecule and protein therapeutics. The immediate priorities are rapid cellular profiling and lead selection for an advanced small-molecule enzyme program, and leadership of cellular development for a transferrin-based protein replacement project. The role will also build fit-for-purpose human neuronal models, laboratory workflows, and external partnerships. Location We welcome applications from candidates located across the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic.

jobs.title: 3D Computer Vision Researcher – Arlington, VA
jobs.description_text: Advance 3D Vision Research from Algorithms to Open Source Applications. In this position, you’ll research and develop algorithms for photogrammetry, camera calibration, registration, and 3D reconstruction from images and video. Current projects emphasize aerial and satellite imagery, with opportunities to adapt these capabilities to new challenges and data domains such as underwater imagery and synthetic aperture radar. Your work will contribute to open source applications and frameworks including TeleSculptor, KWIVER, and Danesfield. You’ll also explore how 3D vision can support broader computer vision problems such as object detection and tracking, change detection, super resolution, and video compression. Kitware partners with government R&D agencies, branches of the U.S. military, members of the Intelligence Community, and commercial organizations ranging from startups to Fortune 500 companies. You’ll have opportunities to collaborate directly with customers, participate in field tests and demonstrations, publish novel work, and apply state-of-the-art artificial intelligence approaches to real-world national security challenges.

jobs.title: Annotation Specialist
jobs.description_text: Team Description: Kitware’s computer vision team is a leader in the creation of cutting-edge algorithms and software for automated image and video analysis. We seek to advance the fields of computer vision and deep learning through research and development and through collaborative projects that build on our open source software platforms. As an Annotation Specialist, you will work on a team of dedicated individuals alongside our R&D Engineers and Researchers to advance the state-of-the-art in computer vision. Annotation is critical to the success of many of our computer vision projects; the annotations are used in scoring and evaluating our work as well as training our algorithms. Kitware’s Annotation team provides the key data annotation support within our computer vision team to meet these needs. The team uses a variety of software tools to label objects, activities, events, and other items of interest in images and video. This is an as-needed, project-dependent position with variable hours. Work availability will ebb and flow based on project needs, and a set number of hours each week is not guaranteed. The position requires flexibility to work on-site at Kitware’s headquarters in Clifton Park, NY when project needs require it, including work in a specialized facility. This position will also require obtaining the necessary government clearances.

jobs.location_raw: Arlington, Virginia · Clifton Park, New York

Kitware’s employees have unique opportunities to interact and collaborate directly with customers, visit interesting customer sites, and participate in live field tests and demonstrations. Research and Development Engineers at Kitware also have the opportunity to publish and maintain open source software packages.

jobs.title: Avionics Engineer
jobs.description_text: Avionics Engineer DESCRIPTION Avionics Engineers play a critical role in mission success, integrating hardware that generates thousands of pounds of thrust with software that ensures precise guidance and control. They drive system architecture, validation, and next-generation avionics development to enable reliable and high-performance flight. This is the lowest-to-highest compensation range we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.

jobs.title: Director, Autonomous Systems
jobs.description_text: Director, Autonomous Systems DESCRIPTION Long Wall is seeking a Director of Autonomous Systems to lead the software, guidance, navigation, and control (GNC), autonomy, and simulation capabilities that underpin the Cyclops interceptor and RSX target vehicle programs. This leader will own the technical strategy and execution required to transform mission objectives into reliable, flight-ready systems. The role combines deep technical leadership with team building and cross-functional execution, spanning algorithms, modeling and simulation, embedded software, perception, autonomy, and vehicle-level integration. Successful candidates will know how to move quickly without compromising engineering rigor. They will guide system-level trades, establish scalable technical foundations, and help teams deliver exceptional performance using cost-effective, producible hardware. In hit-to-kill missile defense, every millisecond matters. This role offers the opportunity to build the team and technology responsible for making those milliseconds count. We also produce containerized launchers and offer low-cost targets for threat replication. The best engineers, technicians, and corporate professionals make their teammates better, knowing that complementary skills create force multiplication and drive mission success. You’ll identify the programs and partners where Machina’s technologies and factories can have the greatest impact, build trusted relationships across European defense companies, and turn those relationships into technical engagements, proof-of-concept programs, qualification programs, and ultimately production opportunities, either fulfilled by Machina factories or deployed at customer sites. You will work closely with Machina’s leadership, defense subsidiary, business development, engineering, and manufacturing teams. This is a remote position based in Europe, with significant travel throughout the region and periodic travel to Machina’s headquarters in Los Angeles. Candidates must reside in Europe.

jobs.description_text: Tu as envie de travailler dans un environnement bienveillant qui avance vite ? 5ème fournisseur français en 10 ans, Octopus Energy est un fournisseur d’énergies renouvelables qui agit comme un véritable fer de lance pour la révolution électro tech. Comment on fait ? On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. Le plus important, ce n’est pas seulement de suivre le mouvement, mais de le créer. On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques. Pourquoi ce poste ? Octopus Energy France connaît une forte croissance sur ses segments B2C, B2B et B2G, et sa fonction Finance se structure en parallèle : migration récente d’Odoo vers NetSuite, automatisation de la chaîne fournisseurs, interfaçage avec les plateformes de facturation, harmonisation avec les standards du groupe au Royaume-Uni. Nous cherchons un·e comptable général senior capable de prendre en main un périmètre critique (marge brute et fiscalité énergie), de le fiabiliser et de le faire évoluer. Plus qu’un·e exécutant·e, tu seras celui ou celle qui identifie les problèmes, en comprend la cause et met en place des solutions durables.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer - Data Platform
jobs.description_text: Every dataset at Spotify, from the data behind creator royalties to the signals powering recommendations, is registered, published and traced through systems our team builds. We're the source of truth for what data exists at Spotify, where it lives, who owns it, and how it flows from one pipeline to the next. These systems sit on the critical path of the platform. Data teams use them every day to publish and find data, and other platform teams build on them for access, retention, governance and incident response. That means our work is judged on correctness and reliability, because every system built on top of ours is only as good as the metadata we provide. This is a backend role focused on data management, working on the problems at the core of any large data platform: running a data catalog that stays accurate at scale, capturing lineage across batch and streaming workloads, managing schemas as they evolve, and guaranteeing that consumers only read complete data. We build on open standards like OpenLineage and Apache Iceberg, and define the internal standards for naming, storage and metadata that the rest of Spotify builds against. As the platform takes on new storage technologies and new kinds of data assets, those standards and the systems behind them have to evolve with it, and you'll help decide how.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer - Data Platform
jobs.description_text: LilEngine is leading the Lakehouse, a company-strategic effort to make Apache Iceberg a first-class citizen in Spotify's data ecosystem. We're building it in close collaboration with Google, on open standards, so that different kinds of data are queryable the same way and teams can bring the right engine, from BigQuery to Dataflow to Trino, to the job. The work has two parts. Hecate enables Iceberg for the Parquet datasets that already exist across Spotify, so teams get the benefits without rewriting their data. Alongside it, we're building the foundations of a new Lakehouse architecture that lets workflows write Iceberg tables natively. We're shipping the MVP this cycle, and you'll help shape what comes next. We also own BigQuery for all of Spotify. Thousands of engineers, data scientists and pipelines depend on it every day, which puts us on the critical path for storing, finding and querying data. We're judged on reliability, cost efficiency and how quickly we unblock users when something breaks. This backend role sits where open table formats, cloud data warehouses and processing engines meet.

The team operates at the intersection of backend platform engineering, machine learning systems, and regulatory compliance, partnering closely with Licensing, Trust & Safety, Legal, and Public Affairs. Spotify Technology brings our proven tools and services together for engineering organisations everywhere, from global enterprises to individual developers. As AI reshapes how software gets made, we're building on years of experience solving complex engineering challenges at scale. Platform Design makes these powerful tools feel effortless. We shape the services, products and experiences used by Spotify's engineering teams and by developers around the world. We believe great design is a competitive advantage, and developer tools deserve the same care and craft as any consumer product. As a Staff Product Designer, you'll combine product leadership with hands-on design and engineering. You'll shape the experience strategy for a key part of the Spotify Technology portfolio, establish a distinctive visual language, and turn internal tools into products customers love using. Communication and attention to detail are core to how you operate, not afterthoughts. You'll be part of a high-accountability, high-expectation team that is just as invested in each other's success as they are in Palantir's mission. Feedback isn't just welcomed here, it's how we get better.

jobs.description_text: The Role We are a software engineering team applying open-source data technologies to some of the world's hardest and most important problems. You will work deep inside the systems that make this possible: how computations are represented, how query plans are optimised, how operators execute, and how data is read and written efficiently. We build on and extend Apache Spark, Apache DataFusion, and Apache Iceberg, bringing advances in open-source engines and table formats into the demanding environments our customers operate in. You will see your work through design, code review, testing, and release. Correctness, compatibility, and predictable performance are central to everything we build, and you will learn how to deliver all three. You will sit with security, platform, and AI engineering teams to assess how generative and agentic systems actually behave at runtime, then design, deploy, tune, and operationalize AI security controls that hold up under production load. jobs.title: AI-First Engineering Intern
jobs.description_text: Why This Role Exists Xsolla is going all-in on becoming an AI-first company, and we're not waiting for a slow rollout to get there. We're offering AI Engineer Internships in regions across the globe to help drive that shift directly, not by sitting in the back office, but by building. You'll work on two things: Internal AI initiatives – helping unlock AI tooling and integrations across Xsolla faster than our existing teams can alone. Proof-of-concept builds on our own APIs – showing our product and engineering teams what's possible when you build with AI as a core part of your workflow, not an afterthought. This isn't a shadow-and-observe internship. You'll ship code that goes to customers – internal teams or external players and game developers – working closely with senior engineers and fellow interns across our global regions. Who You'll Work With You won't be isolated on an intern-only project island. You'll work closely with senior engineers who are actively rebuilding how we write software, and you'll be part of a global cohort of interns building in parallel across our regions. That combination is the point: senior engineers give you a bar for what production-grade, customer-facing code looks like, and your fellow interns give you a peer group to trade ideas, code, and AI workflows every week.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager
jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE: Xsolla is an international IT company that offers a number of services for video games. We create solutions for developers that help to integrate payments, attract users, and publish games all over the world. We also provide round-the-clock technical support. We are trusted by such giants as Twitch, Valve, Epic Games, Take2 and many more. As a Business Development Manager at Xsolla you will be responsible for researching, understanding, and selling Xsolla's products and solutions to clients in Global. Your primary functions will be sourcing and building new partnerships with individuals in the video game community and closing deals. Since this role is connected to the company strategy you will be able to influence decisions on a global level and the director role.

jobs.title: CCA Events & Community Manager
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Baku Events Community Manager who is trustworthy, self-driven, motivated, and accountable to join our Global Experiential Marketing team. The ideal candidate is a natural relationship-builder who thrives on turning event moments into lasting community connections across the games industry in the Caucasus and Central Asia (CCA). This is a regional role: while based in Baku, you will cover the whole CCA region, not only Azerbaijan. You will use your community management, content, and relationship-building skills to grow and nurture Xsolla’s network of partners, developers and clients across the region, working closely with the events team, Social Media Manager, and Marketing colleagues. The right person for this role will be personable, organized, and confident engaging senior industry stakeholders, with a strong instinct for the kind of content and touchpoints that keep a community engaged between events. This role is in-office/on-site in Baku and will require regular regional travel across CCA for events. Longevity Opportunity Vision — Enjoy the game!

ABOUT US Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are working on a hardcore medieval sandbox MMORPG built around player-driven gameplay, crafting, resource management, territorial warfare, and complex economic and progression systems.The project features a mature and highly interconnected gameplay ecosystem and is currently undergoing an active transition to a new game engine.We are looking for a Game Designer who will help us improve existing gameplay systems, develop new mechanics, and shape the future of the project. This role requires a strong understanding of complex game systems, player behavior, and the challenges of evolving an established live MMORPG while adapting to new technology.

jobs.title: Junior Developer (AI Engineering)
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Junior Developer (AI Engineering) to join the Xsolla Partner Network (XPN) team, a platform that connects game studios and publishers with content creators. The position involves participation in all stages of work on an automated content generation system: from stabilising the existing vertical video pipeline for YouTube Shorts, TikTok and Instagram Reels to developing the agentic architecture, launching the virtual AI creator direction and building analytics on the results. Working with the team means applying cutting-edge generative models and agentic tools to a real production product every day, seeing the direct effect of your work in content metrics, and learning from the inside how the games industry, the creator economy and content-driven game promotion work. The developer will work with a live system that has a real audience and measurable results, make technical decisions independently, build expertise in generative AI and take on the role of the project's technical owner as it grows.

jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer Position for Xsolla's Smart Wallet in Web3
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer who has tested real on-chain products — the contracts and the transactions, not only the web app in front of them. You will own quality for Xsolla's smart wallet on Xsolla ZK, our Ethereum-compatible ZK rollup: the wallet players use to hold, receive and send tokens and in-game items, signing in with the account they already have. The work runs on both sides of the chain. On the backend, you will confirm that a wallet address pre-computed from a salt is the address that actually gets deployed. On the frontend, you will follow a signed operation from the client's RPC call through the bundler to finality, and prove it landed, failed or reverted the way it should. You will fork the chain to test against real state, deploy and call contracts from the command line, and turn what you learn into automated suites. You will work in a small, senior engineering team alongside an external wallet-infrastructure partner. You can tell a defect in our code from one in a partner SDK or in the chain itself — and you bring the evidence to show which. AI coding tools are part of how you work every day, and you set them up so the rest of the team gets the same leverage.

This is an individual contributor role with outsized technical scope: you'll be the technical anchor for how millions of players get an on-chain account they never have to think about — setting direction, making hard architectural calls, and raising the bar across the org. Concretely, you'll own the account model behind Xsolla ZK, our zkSync-based L2, and the wallet that sits inside Xsolla App. Every player who signs in with Xsolla ID receives a deterministic, non-custodial smart account — derived from their identity claim, identical on every device, with private keys that never leave the client. That account is not a separate "wallet" screen: it is the player's inventory, and it backs minting, gifting, trading on our Bazaar marketplace, Merkle-based reward airdrops, gas sponsorship, and an in-app dApp browser that exposes the same signer to third-party applications through an EIP-1193 provider. You'll own the primitives underneath all of it: the ERC-4337 user operation lifecycle, EIP-7702 delegation, session keys and origin-bound Smart Sessions, paymaster and gas abstraction strategy, and the custody and recovery roadmap — including the move from raw key export to MPC custody. jobs.description_text: The Marketplace organization at Lyft is responsible for accelerating the growth of the business while delivering on key business and financial metrics, and Pricing sits at the heart of it. The Dynamic Pricing & Offer Selection team uses real-time and historical data to set the price of every ride on Lyft, balancing price and ETA so riders have a great experience and drivers have earning opportunities when and where demand is highest. We also decide which ride options a rider sees, which makes our systems one of the highest-traffic, most business-critical services at the company. We're a tightly integrated team of software engineers and data scientists spread across the US and Canada. Engineers and scientists work side by side to take machine learning and optimization models from research to production while scaling our systems to handle more volume. We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a group of 6-8 engineers. You'll own the reliability and evolution of dynamic pricing systems that operate at Lyft's full scale, partner closely with our technical and product leadership to define the roadmap, and grow a strong team of engineers. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who enjoys going deep on technical tradeoffs, cares equally about operational excellence and business outcomes, and is energized by working in a fast-paced environment with high impact. Our team builds and maintains Lyft's system responsible for providing routes for every ride request on our platform.
